text:
This looks like mid-2012, most likely May 2012.

- Unemployment of 8.1% matches April–May 2012 (April was 8.1%, May 8.2%).
- The 10-year yield at 1.63% fits May 2012, when it fell below 1.6% at month-end.
- The VIX at 24, US equities down 6.6% over the month, and developed ex-US equities down 11.5% match May 2012, when the euro crisis flared up.
- The dollar was up 8% year over year, consistent with euro weakness.
- Long Treasuries returned +9.6% over the month, which also fits May 2012.
- Gold was down 6% over the month, which fits May 2012.
- Headline CPI at 2.3% fits April 2012, the latest published value at the end of May.

Payrolls averaging 176k over three months also fits the data published by then.
